# PRIME-AI

PRIME-AI is the sovereign cognitive infrastructure layer in a three-site constellation. It connects models, memory and reasoning, governed agents, and execution on infrastructure selected and controlled by the deploying organization.

“Sovereign” describes deployment choices: where data resides, who controls access, whether external model or cloud providers are used, and which components run locally. Capabilities depend on the configured environment; the site does not promise that every deployment is fully local or provider-independent.

## Constellation

- [PRIME-AI](https://prime-ai.fr/): sovereign cognitive infrastructure.
- [YACE19AI](https://yace19ai.com): research, models and world models.
- [AMLAZR](https://amlazr.com): execution intelligence and operational applications.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yacine-benhamou-b26386124/): Yacine Benhamou's professional profile.
